description: pi-mono's Input component hardcodes a '> ' prefix before user text. Add this to OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input: render/2 must prepend '> ' to the first display line (subsequent wrapped lines get 2-space indent for alignment). cursor_rc/2 must add +2 to the column offset so the hardware cursor lands after the prefix. The prefix should use the theme's text color (not dimmed). Update interactive.ex cursor_position/3 if it does its own col offset math.
title: Add prompt prefix to Input component
